summary: Fentress County lookout: a wooden tower built in 1942 by the Division of Forestry, replaced in 1960 by an 80-foot Aermotor; now privately owned and restored.

access.note: Privately owned, per the Register. No public access rule or rental listing found.

events.note: First lookout on the mountain: a wooden tower built by the Tennessee Division of Forestry
Replaced by an 80-foot Aermotor tower with a 7x7-foot cab
Registered September 17, 2011; nominated by Kent D. Taylor

evidence.supports: first lookout was a wooden tower built in 1942 by the Division of Forestry
evidence.quote: The first lookout on Wright Mountain was a wooden tower built in 1942 by the Tennessee Div. of Forestry.

evidence.supports: replaced in 1960 with an 80-foot Aermotor tower with 7x7 cab
evidence.quote: The agency replaced it in 1960 with an 80' Aermotor tower with a 7'x7' cab.
It is now privately owned and restored.

evidence.supports: administered by Kent D. Taylor, Owner
registration entry is labelled Date Registered
lookout-history site lists Fentress County and Tennessee Division of Forestry
evidence.quote: Fentress County Tennessee Division of Forestry

evidence.supports: Tennessee Landforms lists the tower as standing

corrections.why: The Register says the 1960 tower replaced a wooden lookout built in 1942, so 1960 is the replacement date, not the first build year.

notes_for_editor: Restoration date and date of ownership change are not in the sources read. Rental status not verified. Register gives the owner and nominator as the same person (Kent D. Taylor). Record built year 1960 corrected to a 1942 first tower and a 1960 replacement. Tennessee Landforms elevation is 1800 ft; the Register gives 1,778 ft, which matches the record's 541.9 m. Two searches and about four page reads used.
